classifications.rationale: The President directs the Administrator’s future exercise of personnel-management authority, including limits and policies for appointments; any appointment occurs later through agency action, and the provision chiefly governs internal staffing.
classifications.evidence: shall be exercised by the Administrator in accordance with the regulations set forth in this part

classifications.rationale: The President prescribes internal appointment procedures, certification, disclosure, delegation, and treatment of agency personnel actions; the Administrator and related officials implement these requirements as executive-branch housekeeping.
classifications.evidence: shall be supported by written certification by the Administrator

classifications.rationale: The Civil Service Commission Chairman must periodically review appointments, report findings, and make recommendations; this creates an internal oversight and reporting process without itself changing legal rights.
classifications.evidence: shall survey appointments made under this part and shall report his findings to the President

classifications.rationale: The President presently exempts covered appointees from specified federal statutory provisions, subject to stated exceptions; that exemption immediately changes their legal obligations, while the later discretionary authority provisions do not displace this self-executing effect.
classifications.evidence: is hereby exempted, with respect to such employment, from the operation of sections 281, 283, 284, 434, and 1914 of Title 18, United States Code
